none: PAS NLM-F7DF50: Roman Coin: Denarius fraction of Severus Alexander from Fridaythorpe
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP ALEXANDER(---) ; R/ PM TRPX II C(--)P

Base Silver. Coin. Denarius fraction of Severus Alexander (222-235), mint of Rome issue of 233, RIC volume 4 part 2 no. 120, Reece period 11. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP ALEXANDER(---). Reverse description: Sol advancing left with his right hand raised and ?a whip? In his left. Reverse inscription: PM TRPX II C(--)P. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin citing Sear volume 2 no. 7915. Diameter: 17.9mm, Weight: 2.02gms, die axis: 6
